generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one finished premium logo symbol for ChatToHarness, a professional desktop developer tool connecting AI chat to a user's local execution environment through a secure tunnel. Icon only, NO typography, NO letters, NO words. Visual idea: a single cohesive geometric mark combines a rounded speech bubble and a terminal-style right-pointing command arrow, joined into one continuous clever silhouette that communicates conversation flowing into local execution. Simple, iconic, legible at 32px. Dark ink navy #142b37 body and deep teal #126c70 with a restrained mint #9ee0d5 accent. Flat vector-like graphic, precise curves, consistent rounded corners, bold clean geometry, excellent negative space. Centered square composition; the symbol occupies approximately 80 percent of the canvas, with even transparent margins. True transparent background. One symbol only, no layout board, no variations, no mockup, no devices, no shadows, no gradients, no glass effect, no decorative circuits, no watermark. It must feel original, trustworthy, restrained, and appropriate for a polished open-source tool.
refinement_prompt: Refine this ChatToHarness logo for final professional production. Preserve exactly its silhouette, proportions and composition: rounded speech-bubble C on the left, rounded teal terminal frame on the right, teal command chevron and mint underscore. Change ONLY surface and edge quality: use absolutely flat, solid uniform colors, navy #142b37, teal #126c70, mint #9ee0d5. Remove all gradients, texture, glow, white speckles, edge grit, scratches, chromatic fringe and halos, especially around the mint underscore. All contours must be immaculate smooth crisp vector-like edges. Same transparent background, same layout, no text, no additional elements.
